pages.description: Write one entry for every page of the request (request), in the same order.

page.description: Write the page number (page) of the request (request.pages) exactly as it is. Do not write the address; the program finds it by the number.

read.description: true when you read the page, false when you could not.

title.description: Write the page's title exactly as the page has it. Empty when you could not read it.

points.description: Write 3 key points of the page, one English sentence each. Empty when you could not read it.

problem.description: When you could not read the page, write why in one sentence. Empty when you read it.
